injection_recovery.note: One sector per injection on stars whose TOIs are all CP/KP, known transits removed, no limb darkening.

note: Out-of-fold test metrics: each star scored once by a model that never saw it. Ensemble threshold and calibration were fit on these same predictions, so they are cross-validated estimates. Labels are TOI CP/KP vs FP/FA; they do not equal the planet fraction among arbitrary signals.
